technical_quality: Adequate PA film; L marker present at upper right of image (patient's left) confirming conventional orientation. Adequate inspiration, trachea midline, minimal rotation, both costophrenic angles included. Slight over-penetration of the lower zones.

devices.type: Round radiopaque external marker / button-snap (~2 cm), not an implant
devices.location: Over the patient's left shoulder, acromioclavicular region

devices.type: Lead 'L' side marker with technologist initials (SH)
devices.location: Upper corner of image on patient's left side

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined hazy airspace opacity in the left lower zone, lateral to and partly overlapping the lower left cardiac border and extending to just above the left hemidiaphragm; lower left heart border and medial left hemidiaphragm slightly indistinct, left costophrenic angle largely preserved, no air-fluid level - consistent with left lower zone consolidation (lingula / left lower lobe)
Prominent, rounded aortic knob suggesting an unfolded / tortuous thoracic aorta; heart size within normal limits (CTR approximately 0.48)
Mildly accentuated bronchovascular markings at the right lower zone medially near the right cardiophrenic angle, without definite consolidation; right hemidiaphragm and costophrenic angle sharp

description_zh: PA正面胸部X光，吸氣量尚可，氣管居中，影像右上角可見 L 側標記。左下肺野可見一片邊界不清的模糊浸潤性陰影，位於左心緣外側並向下延伸至橫膈上方（約10公分），左心緣下段及左橫膈內側輪廓略為模糊，左肋膈角大致保留，未見氣液平面，符合左下肺（舌葉／左下葉）實變之表現。右肺野清晰，右橫膈及肋膈角銳利；心影大小在正常範圍，主動脈弓略為突出（主動脈迂曲）。左肩鎖關節區可見一圓形高密度體表外物（標記或鈕扣），未見胸管、導管、心律調節器或其他置入物，亦無已接受治療的證據。
